rationale: Motor-vehicle collision with totaled vehicle and policyholder injury; third-party liability documented via police report.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan's vehicle was rear-ended on Route 9 yesterday morning at ~8:15 AM by another vehicle traveling ~35 mph with no braking. The vehicle is totaled with severe damage to the trunk/rear structure. Policyholder sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. A police report has been filed with the other driver's insurance information.

case_facts.description: Rear-end collision, other vehicle traveling ~35 mph with no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled, entire trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.police_report: yes, filed; other driver's insurance on report
